en: Quincy Rowan-Pike
Welcome, welcome, to Pennant Hall! I'm Quincy Rowan-Pike, and this hall and its ledger are in my keeping.
Every stall here hails from a region whose Champion has passed through. You choose which stall stands at each pitch.
Each pennant the hall earns raises its rank, and every rank opens another pitch and finer wares.
Our guests pay their way in pennants, and so does the Week's Work, the board of missions on the wall.
How may the ledger serve you?
SET A STALL
THE LEDGER
TODAY'S GUESTS
NOTHING
Mind the bunting on your way out. Do come again!
You hold {pennants} pennants, and the hall stands at rank {number}.
Earn {number} more and the hall rises a rank.
The hall stands at its very highest rank. The ledger has never looked finer!
{number} guests have come today. Do say hello: the first word of the day costs them a pennant or two.
Not a single guest today, I'm afraid. Perhaps tomorrow!
The hall has {number} pitches at its rank. The first four stand along the north wall, the rest in the row across the middle.
Which pitch?

Done! The ledger is updated, and the stall stands ready.
That pitch opens at a higher rank. Earn the hall some pennants and it's yours!
Fine wares from every harbour, priced in pennants! The higher the hall's rank, the finer my shelves.
Welcome to the Lottery Corner's Pennant Hall branch! Same lucky number, same prizes as in Jubilife.
Shall I check today's number against your Pokémon?
Today's lucky number is {ticket}! Let me look through your Pokémon's ID numbers...
Not a single digit matched today, I'm afraid. A new number comes up tomorrow!
The last digit matches {winner}'s ID! That's the fifth prize.
The last two digits match {winner}'s ID! That's the fourth prize.
The last three digits match {winner}'s ID! That's the third prize.
Four digits match {winner}'s ID! That's the second prize!
Every digit matches {winner}'s ID! Incredible! That's the first prize!
Today's draw is done, here or in Jubilife: the number is the same everywhere. Come back tomorrow!
Come back any time today. The number won't run away!
Seals for your Ball Capsules! I've the same stock as the market in Sunyshore, day by day.
Seals for sale! ...But you've no Seal Case to put them in. A house in Solaceon Town gives them away.
A pot, a spoon and a Berry: that's all it takes for a Poffin. Shall we stir?
Come back and stir whenever you like!
Oh, but you'll need a Poffin Case to keep them in. The Pokémon Fan Club in Hearthome gives them out.
Not a single Berry in your bag! Bring some along and we'll stir.
Your Poffin Case is full to the brim! Feed a few to your Pokémon first.
I remember every move a Pokémon learns as it grows, and I can teach one back for a Heart Scale.
Bring a Heart Scale and I'll gladly help. The goods stall here sells them for pennants.
Shall I trade your Heart Scale for a move one of your Pokémon has let slip?
Which Pokémon is it to be?
One, two, and... poof! {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...
{wearer} remembered {thing}!
An Egg hasn't learned a thing yet, let alone forgotten one!
That one hasn't let a single move slip. A fine memory!
Come back whenever a Pokémon of yours wants a move back.
I take Apricorns for Kurt of Azalea Town. Whatever I take, he makes, and it's ready the day after.
Shall I send him every Apricorn of one colour from your Box?
Which colour?
Red
Blue
Yellow
Green
Other colours
Never mind
Which colour?
Pink
White
Black
Back
You've no {apricorn} in your Box. Try another colour.
Sent! That's {apricorns} × {ball} on their way. Come back tomorrow, here or at Kurt's.
Kurt's batch came in on the morning boat: {apricorns} × {ball}, all yours.
{apricorns} × {ball} went into the bag.
Kurt's still at work on your {ball}: {apricorns} of them, ready tomorrow.
Bring Apricorns in your Apricorn Box and I'll send them to Kurt. Each colour makes a ball of its own.
No hurry. Kurt's always glad of Apricorns.
Berries in, Pokéblocks out! This blender came all the way from Lilycove.
You'll need a Pokéblock Case to keep what we make. Lilycove's Contest Hall gives them out.
Choose a Berry to blend. The more it stands out from mine, the better the Pokéblock.
A fine Pokéblock! It's in your Case.
Your Pokéblock Case is full. Feed a few to your Pokémon first.
Hello! I've come a long way to see this hall. Here, a few pennants for the stalls.
{player} received {number} pennants!
Fancy a battle? I've brought my strongest team.
Ha! Good fun. Come back and try me again today if you like.
What a battle! The hall pays its guests' winners, and today that's you.
{player} received {number} pennants!
You beat me fair and square today. Tomorrow I'll be ready!
Enjoy the hall! There's something new at every stall.
